NEW_GAME_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_MAIN: Create a new TTRPG game channel set.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.OPTION_NAME: The name of your new game.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.OPTION_ABBREVIATION: A short, unique abbreviation for your game (2-6 alphanumeric chars).
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.OPTION_SYSTEM: The game system being played (e.g., D&D 5e, Pathfinder, Custom).
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.OPTION_DESCRIPTION: A brief description of your game.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.OPTION_PRIVATE: Set the game channels to be private (only GMs and Players see them).
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.OPTION_MAX_PLAYERS: Maximum number of players for this game.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.OPTION_OVERRIDE_ROSTER_MODE: Override server's default GM/Player roster management mode.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.INVALID_ABBREVIATION_FORMAT: Invalid abbreviation format. Must be 2-6 alphanumeric characters.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.DUPLICATE_ABBREVIATION: A game with abbreviation '{abbreviation}' already exists. Please choose a unique one.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.GM_REQUIRED_MISSING: GM 1 is a required field. Please specify at least one GM.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.ROLE_RESTRICTED_NO_ROLE_SET: Game creation is restricted by role, but no allowed role has been configured by a server admin.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to use this command in this server.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.INVALID_SERVER_CONFIG: The server's game creation configuration is invalid. Please contact a server admin.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.MOD_CHANNEL_NOT_SET: This server requires approval for new games, but no moderator channel is set. Please contact a server admin.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.MOD_CHANNEL_INVALID: The configured moderator channel is invalid or inaccessible. Please contact a server admin.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.GAME_NOT_FOUND_AFTER_CREATION: The game was created in the database but could not be retrieved. Please contact support.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_SUCCESS: Your new game, **{gameName}**, has been set up!
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.APPROVAL_REQUEST_DESCRIPTION: A new game has been requested by {userTag} and requires your approval.
NEW_GAME_COMMAND.APPROVAL_REQUEST_SUBMITTED: Your game creation request has been submitted for approval.

GAME_MANAGER.BOT_HIERARCHY_TOO_LOW: Scryarc's role is too low to manage roles or channels. Please ensure my highest role is above the roles I need to manage. Reason: {reason}
GAME_MANAGER.TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: The default game template '{templateId}' was not found. Please ensure it exists and is correctly configured.
GAME_MANAGER.BOT_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: The bot's member object could not be found in this guild. Cannot set permissions.
GAME_MANAGER.NO_VALID_CATEGORY: No valid category could be found or created for game channels.
GAME_MANAGER.WELCOME_DESCRIPTION: Your new campaign space has been successfully created by Scryarc!
GAME_MANAGER.GM_INSTRUCTIONS_GREETING: <@{gmId}>, here are some quick tips to get started:
GAME_MANAGER.GM_INSTRUCTIONS_CONTENT:
- Use `/game roster_view` to see your current GMs and Players.
- Use `/game add_player` or `/game add_gm` to invite others to your game.
- Use `/game remove_player` or `/game remove_gm` to manage your roster.
- Check `/config` for server settings.

INTERACTION_HANDLER.APPROVAL_PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to approve or deny game creation requests.
INTERACTION_HANDLER.NO_PENDING_APPROVAL: This game approval request is no longer pending or does not exist.
INTERACTION_HANDLER.REQUESTER_NOT_FOUND: The original requester of this game could not be found in the server. Denying request.
INTERACTION_HANDLER.GAME_APPROVED_DM_DESCRIPTION: Your request to create the game **{gameName}** on **{serverName}** has been approved!
INTERACTION_HANDLER.GAME_APPROVED_REPLY: Game approved and channels created! See <#{channelId}> for the main channel.
INTERACTION_HANDLER.GAME_DENIED_DM_DESCRIPTION: Your request to create the game **{gameName}** on **{serverName}** was denied.

HELP_COMMAND.TITLE: Scryarc Bot Help
HELP_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION: Here are the commands you can use with Scryarc:
HELP_COMMAND.CMD_NEW_GAME: Create a new TTRPG game with dedicated channels.
HELP_COMMAND.CMD_ARCHIVE_GAME: Archive an existing game, making its channels read-only.
HELP_COMMAND.BUG_REPORT_INSTRUCTION: If you encounter any issues, please use the debug button below and provide the output to the developers in the support server.
HELP_COMMAND.DEBUG_DM_DESCRIPTION: Here is the requested debug information:

CONFIG_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_MAIN: Configure Scryarc's behavior for your server.
CONFIG_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_VIEW_SUB: View the current server configuration for Scryarc.
CONFIG_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_MODIFY_SUB: Modify various server configuration settings for Scryarc.
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_MODE: Set the default game creation mode for this server.
CONFIG_COMMAND.MODE_ROLE_RESTRICTED: Role Restricted (Only specific role can create games)
CONFIG_COMMAND.MODE_APPROVAL: Approval (Requires moderator approval for new games)
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_ALLOWED_ROLE: The role allowed to create games (if mode is 'Role Restricted').
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_PUBLIC_CATEGORY: The category for public game channels (if 'existing_category' style).
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_PRIVATE_CATEGORY: The category for private game channels (if 'existing_category' style).
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_MODERATOR_CHANNEL: The channel for new game approval requests (if mode is 'Approval').
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_NAMING_TEMPLATE: Template for new channel names. Use {GameName}, {GameAbbr}, etc. Use {DEFAULT} to reset.
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_DEFAULT_GAME_TEMPLATE: The default game template to use for new games. Use {CLEAR} to remove.
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_GM_ROSTER_MODE: How GMs are managed for new games.
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_PLAYER_ROSTER_MODE: How Players are managed for new games.
CONFIG_COMMAND.ROSTER_MODE_MASTER_ROLE: Master Role (Assign to a single server-wide role)
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_MASTER_GM_ROLE: The existing role to use for all GMs (if GM Roster Mode is 'Master Role').
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_MASTER_PLAYER_ROLE: The existing role to use for all Players (if Player Roster Mode is 'Master Role').
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_GM_ROLE_NAMING_TEMPLATE: Template for auto-created GM roles. Use {GameName}, {GMUsername}, etc.
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_PLAYER_ROLE_NAMING_TEMPLATE: Template for auto-created Player roles. Use {GameName}, {PlayerUsername}, etc.
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_DEFAULT_PERMISSION_PROFILE_ID: The ID or name of the default permission profile. Use {CLEAR} to remove.
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_GAME_ADMIN_ROLE: The role for users who can manage all games. Use to clear.
CONFIG_COMMAND.OPTION_CONFIG_ADMIN_ROLE: The role for users who can manage all Scryarc config. Use to clear.
CONFIG_COMMAND.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to configure Scryarc for this server. Only server administrators or designated config admins can do this.
CONFIG_COMMAND.ROLE_UPDATE_SUCCESS_DESCRIPTION: Allowed role for game creation updated to: **{roleName}**.
CONFIG_COMMAND.ROLE_CLEARED_DESCRIPTION: Allowed role for game creation cleared. Mode is now effectively 'Open' if set to 'Role Restricted'.
CONFIG_COMMAND.INVALID_PUBLIC_CATEGORY_TYPE: Invalid public category specified. Must be a category channel.
CONFIG_COMMAND.INVALID_PRIVATE_CATEGORY_TYPE: Invalid private category specified. Must be a category channel.
CONFIG_COMMAND.MOD_CHANNEL_UPDATE_SUCCESS_DESCRIPTION: Moderator channel for approval requests updated.
CONFIG_COMMAND.MOD_CHANNEL_CLEARED: Moderator channel for approval requests cleared. Approval mode is now effectively 'Open'.
CONFIG_COMMAND.INVALID_MODERATOR_CHANNEL_TYPE: Invalid moderator channel specified. Must be a text channel.
CONFIG_COMMAND.NAMING_TEMPLATE_UPDATE_SUCCESS_DESCRIPTI: Channel naming template updated and corrected to: `{newTemplate}`.
CONFIG_COMMAND.NAMING_TEMPLATE_INVALID_DESCRIPTION: Invalid placeholders detected: {invalidPlaceholders}. Template not updated. Available: {GameName}, {GameAbbr}, {GameSystem}, {GMUsername}, {YYYY}, {MM}, {DD}.
CONFIG_COMMAND.NAMING_TEMPLATE_CLEARED: Channel naming template reset to default.
CONFIG_COMMAND.DEFAULT_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: Permission profile with ID/name '{profileId}' not found.
CONFIG_COMMAND.DEFAULT_GAME_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: Game template with ID '{templateId}' not found.
CONFIG_COMMAND.GM_ROSTER_MODE_UPDATED: GM roster management mode updated to: **{mode}**.
CONFIG_COMMAND.PLAYER_ROSTER_MODE_UPDATED: Player roster management mode updated to: **{mode}**.
CONFIG_COMMAND.ROLE_HIERARCHY_WARNING: Warning: The bot's role hierarchy is too low to manage the role **{roleName}**. Reason: {reason}
CONFIG_COMMAND.NO_CHANGES_DESCRIPTION: No changes were applied as the new values were the same as the current configuration.
CONFIG_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_VIEW: Below are the current settings for Scryarc on this server.
CONFIG_COMMAND.PERMISSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Manage permission profiles for GMs and other roles.
CONFIG_COMMAND.PERMISSIONS_NO_PROFILES: No custom permission profiles found. Use `/config permissions add` to create one.
CONFIG_COMMAND.PERMISSIONS_PREMIUM_DESCRIPTION: Unlimited custom permission profiles are a premium feature. Free tier limited to {limit} profiles.

GAME_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_MAIN: Manage existing games, including roster, status, and channels.
GAME_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_ROSTER_VIEW: View the current GMs and Players for a game.
GAME_COMMAND.ROSTER_VIEW_DESCRIPTION: Current GMs and Players for game '{abbreviation}'.
GAME_COMMAND.GAME_NOT_FOUND: Game with abbreviation '{abbreviation}' not found. Please check the abbreviation and try again.
GAME_COMMAND.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to manage this game.
GAME_COMMAND.INVALID_TARGET_TYPE: Invalid target. Please mention a user or a role.
GAME_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_ADD_PLAYER: Add a user or role as a player to a game.
GAME_COMMAND.OPTION_TARGET: The user or role to add.
GAME_COMMAND.ADD_PLAYER_ALREADY_PLAYER: {target} is already a player in this game.
GAME_COMMAND.ADD_PLAYER_SUCCESS: Successfully added {target} as a player to **{gameName}**.
GAME_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_REMOVE_PLAYER: Remove a user or role as a player from a game.
GAME_COMMAND.REMOVE_PLAYER_NOT_PLAYER: {target} is not a player in this game.
GAME_COMMAND.REMOVE_PLAYER_PRIMARY_ROLE_ERROR: Cannot remove the primary player role via this command. Please use `/config` to change the roster management mode if you wish to remove the primary role.
GAME_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_ADD_GM: Add a user or role as a GM to a game.
GAME_COMMAND.ADD_GM_ALREADY_GM: {target} is already a GM for this game.
GAME_COMMAND.ADD_GM_SUCCESS: Successfully added {target} as a GM to **{gameName}**.
GAME_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_REMOVE_GM: Remove a user or role as a GM from a game.
GAME_COMMAND.REMOVE_GM_NOT_GM: {target} is not a GM for this game.
GAME_COMMAND.REMOVE_GM_LAST_GM_ERROR: Cannot remove the last GM from a game. A game must always have at least one GM.
GAME_COMMAND.REMOVE_GM_PRIMARY_ROLE_ERROR: Cannot remove the primary GM role via this command. Please use `/config` to change the roster management mode if you wish to remove the primary role.
GAME_COMMAND.ROLE_MANAGEMENT_FAILED: Failed to manage Discord role for the participant. Please check bot permissions.
